changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0061. Named coach targets plus commission rules, performance incentives, and calculation history. Index review: PK on each id; IX by tenant and trainer; UX_TrainerCompensationCalculations_Open blocks a second open calculation for the same rule and period. Performance note: coach detail reads filter TenantId and TrainerProfileId. Paid status is not stored because no payout table exists.
